-- Contour schema-scoped install for {{schema}}.
-- Rendered by `contour-migrate --schema {{schema}}`. Do not edit the output by hand.
--
-- Built from apps/ops-demo/supabase/migrations (core, oauth_extras, retention,
-- review_hardening) with these changes for a generic company install:
--  * Every object lives in {{schema}}. Nothing touches the public schema.
--  * Company tables (tenants, apps, membership rows, demo data) are not
--    created. Membership comes from the host's identity.getMembership adapter.
--  * subject_id is text with no FK to the auth schema (company IDs are not
--    always Supabase auth UUIDs).
--  * contour_apply_proposal / contour_commit_snapshot take the caller's fresh
--    role version as p->>'role_version' instead of reading a membership row.
--  * Service-role only: RLS is enabled on every table with no policies, and
--    anon/authenticated hold no privileges on anything in {{schema}}.
--  * Idempotent: safe to re-run (if not exists, create or replace, guarded
--    constraint adds).

begin;

create schema if not exists {{schema}};

-- ------------------------------------------------------------ settings
create table if not exists {{schema}}.tenant_app_settings (
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  agent_access_enabled boolean not null default true,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_by text,
  primary key (tenant_id, app_id)
);

create table if not exists {{schema}}.surface_manifests (
  app_id text not null,
  surface_id text not null,
  manifest_version text not null,
  policy_version text not null,
  manifest_hash text not null,
  manifest jsonb not null,
  deployed_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (app_id, surface_id, manifest_version, policy_version)
);

-- --------------------------------------------------------- user state
create table if not exists {{schema}}.user_preferences (
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text not null,
  surface_id text not null,
  expertise text check (expertise in ('beginner', 'expert')),
  density text check (density in ('comfortable', 'compact')),
  help text not null default 'auto' check (help in ('auto', 'show', 'hide')),
  pins jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb check (jsonb_typeof(pins) = 'array' and jsonb_array_length(pins) <= 12),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id)
);

create table if not exists {{schema}}.user_views (
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text not null,
  surface_id text not null,
  revision integer not null check (revision >= 0),
  parent_revision integer,
  manifest_version text not null,
  policy_version text not null,
  config jsonb not null,
  config_hash text not null,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id)
);

create table if not exists {{schema}}.view_history (
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text not null,
  surface_id text not null,
  revision integer not null,
  parent_revision integer,
  source text not null check (source in ('default', 'proposal', 'undo', 'reset')),
  proposal_id uuid,
  manifest_version text not null,
  policy_version text not null,
  config jsonb not null,
  config_hash text not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, revision)
);

create table if not exists {{schema}}.proposals (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text not null,
  surface_id text not null,
  client_id text not null,
  base_revision integer not null,
  manifest_version text not null,
  policy_version text not null,
  role_version integer not null,
  config jsonb not null,
  config_hash text not null,
  candidate_id text not null,
  status text not null check (status in ('READY', 'APPLIED', 'REJECTED', 'EXPIRED', 'STALE', 'INVALID')),
  status_reason text,
  task text not null,
  expertise text not null,
  preferences jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  changes jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  rationale text not null default '',
  decision_id uuid not null,
  job_id uuid not null unique,
  request_id text not null check (length(request_id) between 8 and 128),
  request_hash text not null,
  expires_at timestamptz not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  applied_at timestamptz,
  applied_revision integer,
  unique (tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, request_id)
);
create index if not exists proposals_owner_idx on {{schema}}.proposals(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, created_at desc);

create table if not exists {{schema}}.approvals (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  proposal_id uuid not null unique references {{schema}}.proposals(id),
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text not null,
  surface_id text not null,
  config_hash text not null,
  base_revision integer not null,
  proposal_expires_at timestamptz not null,
  approved_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  idempotency_key text not null,
  channel text not null check (channel = 'host')
);

create table if not exists {{schema}}.idempotency_keys (
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text not null,
  surface_id text not null,
  operation text not null,
  key text not null check (length(key) between 8 and 128),
  request_hash text not null,
  response jsonb not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, operation, key)
);

-- ------------------------------------------------------- observability
create table if not exists {{schema}}.decision_events (
  id uuid primary key,
  job_id uuid not null,
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text not null,
  surface_id text not null,
  client_id text not null,
  channel text not null,
  manifest_version text not null,
  policy_version text not null,
  model_version text,
  candidate_ids text[] not null default '{}',
  candidate_hashes jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  selected_id text,
  distribution jsonb,
  confidence double precision,
  confidence_floor double precision,
  inputs jsonb not null,
  assumptions jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  validation text not null,
  validation_rules jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  outcome text not null,
  outcome_reason text,
  provider_status text not null,
  provider_latency_ms integer,
  total_latency_ms integer,
  input_tokens integer,
  output_tokens integer,
  provider_cost numeric(12, 8),
  currency text,
  rationale text,
  proposal_id uuid,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists decision_events_owner_idx on {{schema}}.decision_events(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, created_at desc);
create index if not exists decision_events_app_idx on {{schema}}.decision_events(tenant_id, app_id, created_at desc);

create table if not exists {{schema}}.usage_events (
  job_id uuid primary key,
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text not null,
  provider text not null,
  model_version text,
  provider_usage jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  provider_cost numeric(12, 8),
  currency text,
  status text not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists {{schema}}.audit_events (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text,
  surface_id text,
  kind text not null,
  ref text,
  detail jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
-- The schema may already own an audit_events table (Cloud's registry log has
-- contour_user/project_id columns). Add the Contour columns, nullable, so both
-- writers share one table. No-op on a table created just above.
alter table {{schema}}.audit_events
  add column if not exists tenant_id text,

-- Defence in depth: OAuth rows can never carry a scope outside the agent set
-- (never the commit scope), regardless of application code.
do $$
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from pg_constraint
                 where conrelid = '{{schema}}.oauth_grants'::regclass and conname = 'oauth_grants_agent_scopes_only') then
    alter table {{schema}}.oauth_grants add constraint oauth_grants_agent_scopes_only
      check (scopes <@ array['view:read', 'data:read', 'view:propose']::text[]);
  end if;
  if not exists (select 1 from pg_constraint
                 where conrelid = '{{schema}}.oauth_codes'::regclass and conname = 'oauth_codes_agent_scopes_only') then
    alter table {{schema}}.oauth_codes add constraint oauth_codes_agent_scopes_only
      check (scopes <@ array['view:read', 'data:read', 'view:propose']::text[]);
  end if;
  if not exists (select 1 from pg_constraint
                 where conrelid = '{{schema}}.oauth_tokens'::regclass and conname = 'oauth_tokens_agent_scopes_only') then
    alter table {{schema}}.oauth_tokens add constraint oauth_tokens_agent_scopes_only
      check (scopes <@ array['view:read', 'data:read', 'view:propose']::text[]);
  end if;
end $$;

-- ===================================================== transactional RPCs
-- SECURITY INVOKER, fixed empty search_path, executable only by service_role.
-- They return jsonb {ok, code, ...} rather than raising for business outcomes
-- so that status transitions (e.g. STALE) persist.

-- Reserve one available credit for an adaptation job. Releases stale
-- reservations (older than 10 minutes, no proposal) first.
create or replace function {{schema}}.contour_reserve_credit(
  p_tenant text, p_app text, p_subject text, p_job uuid
) returns jsonb
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_credit {{schema}}.credits;
begin
  with stale as (
    update {{schema}}.credits c set status = 'available', job_id = null, reserved_at = null
    where c.tenant_id = p_tenant and c.app_id = p_app and c.subject_id = p_subject
      and c.status = 'reserved' and c.reserved_at < now() - interval '10 minutes'
    returning c.*
  )
  insert into {{schema}}.credit_ledger(credit_id, tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, kind, job_id)
  select s.id, s.tenant_id, s.app_id, s.subject_id, 'release', null from stale s;

  -- Idempotent: an existing reservation for this job is returned as-is.
  select * into v_credit from {{schema}}.credits where job_id = p_job;
  if found then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'creditId', v_credit.id, 'status', v_credit.status);
  end if;

  select * into v_credit from {{schema}}.credits c
  where c.tenant_id = p_tenant and c.app_id = p_app and c.subject_id = p_subject and c.status = 'available'
  order by c.created_at
  for update skip locked
  limit 1;
  if not found then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'PAYMENT_REQUIRED');
  end if;

  update {{schema}}.credits set status = 'reserved', job_id = p_job, reserved_at = now() where id = v_credit.id;
  insert into {{schema}}.credit_ledger(credit_id, tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, kind, job_id)
  values (v_credit.id, p_tenant, p_app, p_subject, 'reserve', p_job);
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'creditId', v_credit.id, 'status', 'reserved');
end;
$$;

create or replace function {{schema}}.contour_release_credit(p_job uuid) returns jsonb
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_credit {{schema}}.credits;
begin
  select * into v_credit from {{schema}}.credits where job_id = p_job for update;
  if not found or v_credit.status <> 'reserved' then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'released', false);
  end if;
  update {{schema}}.credits set status = 'available', job_id = null, reserved_at = null where id = v_credit.id;
  insert into {{schema}}.credit_ledger(credit_id, tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, kind, job_id)
  values (v_credit.id, v_credit.tenant_id, v_credit.app_id, v_credit.subject_id, 'release', p_job);
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'released', true);
end;
$$;

-- Persist a READY proposal and consume the job's reserved credit in one
-- transaction. Idempotent per (owner, request_id): identical payload returns
-- the existing proposal, a different payload is rejected.
create or replace function {{schema}}.contour_create_proposal(p jsonb) returns jsonb
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_existing {{schema}}.proposals;
  v_credit {{schema}}.credits;
  v_id uuid;
  v_job uuid := (p->>'job_id')::uuid;
  v_subject text := p->>'subject_id';
begin
  select * into v_existing from {{schema}}.proposals
  where tenant_id = p->>'tenant_id' and app_id = p->>'app_id' and subject_id = v_subject
    and surface_id = p->>'surface_id' and request_id = p->>'request_id';
  if found then
    if v_existing.request_hash = p->>'request_hash' then
      return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'replayed', true, 'proposalId', v_existing.id, 'jobId', v_existing.job_id);
    end if;
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT');
  end if;

  select * into v_credit from {{schema}}.credits where job_id = v_job for update;
  if not found or v_credit.status <> 'reserved'
     or v_credit.subject_id <> v_subject or v_credit.tenant_id <> p->>'tenant_id' or v_credit.app_id <> p->>'app_id' then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'PAYMENT_REQUIRED');
  end if;

  insert into {{schema}}.proposals(
    tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, client_id, base_revision, manifest_version, policy_version,
    role_version, config, config_hash, candidate_id, status, task, expertise, preferences, changes, rationale,
    decision_id, job_id, request_id, request_hash, expires_at
  ) values (
    p->>'tenant_id', p->>'app_id', v_subject, p->>'surface_id', p->>'client_id', (p->>'base_revision')::int,
    p->>'manifest_version', p->>'policy_version', (p->>'role_version')::int, p->'config', p->>'config_hash',
    p->>'candidate_id', 'READY', p->>'task', p->>'expertise', coalesce(p->'preferences', '{}'::jsonb),
    coalesce(p->'changes', '[]'::jsonb), coalesce(p->>'rationale', ''), (p->>'decision_id')::uuid, v_job,
    p->>'request_id', p->>'request_hash', (p->>'expires_at')::timestamptz
  ) returning id into v_id;

  update {{schema}}.credits set status = 'consumed', consumed_at = now(), proposal_id = v_id where id = v_credit.id;
  insert into {{schema}}.credit_ledger(credit_id, tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, kind, job_id)
  values (v_credit.id, v_credit.tenant_id, v_credit.app_id, v_credit.subject_id, 'consume', v_job);

  insert into {{schema}}.audit_events(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, kind, ref, detail)
  values (p->>'tenant_id', p->>'app_id', v_subject, p->>'surface_id', 'proposal_created', v_id::text,
          jsonb_build_object('jobId', v_job, 'clientId', p->>'client_id', 'candidateId', p->>'candidate_id'));
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'replayed', false, 'proposalId', v_id, 'jobId', v_job, 'creditId', v_credit.id);
end;
$$;

-- Internal: lock (creating if needed) the owner's active view row.
create or replace function {{schema}}.contour_lock_view(
  p_tenant text, p_app text, p_subject text, p_surface text,
  p_default_config jsonb, p_default_hash text, p_manifest_version text, p_policy_version text
) returns {{schema}}.user_views
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_view {{schema}}.user_views;
begin
  insert into {{schema}}.user_views(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, revision, parent_revision,
    manifest_version, policy_version, config, config_hash)
  values (p_tenant, p_app, p_subject, p_surface, 0, null, p_manifest_version, p_policy_version, p_default_config, p_default_hash)
  on conflict do nothing;
  insert into {{schema}}.view_history(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, revision, parent_revision, source,
    manifest_version, policy_version, config, config_hash)
  values (p_tenant, p_app, p_subject, p_surface, 0, null, 'default', p_manifest_version, p_policy_version, p_default_config, p_default_hash)
  on conflict do nothing;
  select * into v_view from {{schema}}.user_views
  where tenant_id = p_tenant and app_id = p_app and subject_id = p_subject and surface_id = p_surface
  for update;
  return v_view;
end;
$$;

-- Approve + apply a stored proposal atomically (host-only flow).
-- Membership is the host's: the broker re-checks it through
-- identity.getMembership immediately before this call and passes the fresh
-- role version as p->>'role_version'. A missing role version is refused.
create or replace function {{schema}}.contour_apply_proposal(p jsonb) returns jsonb
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_tenant text := p->>'tenant_id';
  v_app text := p->>'app_id';
  v_subject text := p->>'subject_id';
  v_surface text := p->>'surface_id';
  v_key text := p->>'idempotency_key';
  v_req_hash text := p->>'request_hash';
  v_role_version integer := nullif(p->>'role_version', '')::int;
  v_idem {{schema}}.idempotency_keys;
  v_prop {{schema}}.proposals;
  v_view {{schema}}.user_views;
  v_new_rev integer;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_idem from {{schema}}.idempotency_keys
  where tenant_id = v_tenant and app_id = v_app and subject_id = v_subject and surface_id = v_surface
    and operation = 'apply' and key = v_key;
  if found then
    if v_idem.request_hash = v_req_hash then
      return v_idem.response || jsonb_build_object('replayed', true);
    end if;
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT');
  end if;

  select * into v_prop from {{schema}}.proposals where id = (p->>'proposal_id')::uuid for update;
  -- Wrong owner is indistinguishable from not found.
  if not found or v_prop.tenant_id <> v_tenant or v_prop.app_id <> v_app
     or v_prop.subject_id <> v_subject or v_prop.surface_id <> v_surface then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'NOT_FOUND');
  end if;
  if v_prop.status <> 'READY' then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'PROPOSAL_NOT_READY', 'status', v_prop.status);
  end if;
  if v_prop.expires_at <= now() then
    update {{schema}}.proposals set status = 'EXPIRED', status_reason = 'expired before approval' where id = v_prop.id;
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'EXPIRED_PROPOSAL');
  end if;
  if v_prop.config_hash <> p->>'config_hash' then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'HASH_MISMATCH');
  end if;

  if v_role_version is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'FORBIDDEN');
  end if;
  if v_prop.manifest_version <> p->>'manifest_version' or v_prop.policy_version <> p->>'policy_version'
     or v_prop.role_version <> v_role_version then
    update {{schema}}.proposals set status = 'INVALID', status_reason = 'manifest, policy or role changed' where id = v_prop.id;
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'INCOMPATIBLE_MANIFEST');
  end if;

  v_view := {{schema}}.contour_lock_view(v_tenant, v_app, v_subject, v_surface, p->'default_config', p->>'default_hash',
                                         p->>'manifest_version', p->>'policy_version');
  if v_view.revision <> v_prop.base_revision then
    update {{schema}}.proposals set status = 'STALE', status_reason = 'base revision changed' where id = v_prop.id;
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'STALE_REVISION', 'currentRevision', v_view.revision);
  end if;

  v_new_rev := v_view.revision + 1;
  update {{schema}}.user_views set revision = v_new_rev, parent_revision = v_view.revision, config = v_prop.config,
    config_hash = v_prop.config_hash, manifest_version = v_prop.manifest_version, policy_version = v_prop.policy_version,
    updated_at = now()
  where tenant_id = v_tenant and app_id = v_app and subject_id = v_subject and surface_id = v_surface;
  insert into {{schema}}.view_history(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, revision, parent_revision, source,
    proposal_id, manifest_version, policy_version, config, config_hash)
  values (v_tenant, v_app, v_subject, v_surface, v_new_rev, v_view.revision, 'proposal', v_prop.id,
    v_prop.manifest_version, v_prop.policy_version, v_prop.config, v_prop.config_hash);
  insert into {{schema}}.approvals(proposal_id, tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, config_hash, base_revision,
    proposal_expires_at, idempotency_key, channel)
  values (v_prop.id, v_tenant, v_app, v_subject, v_surface, v_prop.config_hash, v_prop.base_revision,
    v_prop.expires_at, v_key, 'host');
  update {{schema}}.proposals set status = 'APPLIED', applied_at = now(), applied_revision = v_new_rev where id = v_prop.id;
  insert into {{schema}}.audit_events(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, kind, ref, detail)
  values (v_tenant, v_app, v_subject, v_surface, 'view_committed', v_prop.id::text,
    jsonb_build_object('revision', v_new_rev, 'jobId', v_prop.job_id, 'configHash', v_prop.config_hash));

  delete from {{schema}}.view_history h
  where h.tenant_id = v_tenant and h.app_id = v_app and h.subject_id = v_subject and h.surface_id = v_surface
    and h.revision <= v_new_rev - coalesce((p->>'history_limit')::int, 20);

  v_result := jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'revision', v_new_rev, 'proposalId', v_prop.id, 'configHash', v_prop.config_hash);
  insert into {{schema}}.idempotency_keys(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, operation, key, request_hash, response)
  values (v_tenant, v_app, v_subject, v_surface, 'apply', v_key, v_req_hash, v_result);
  return v_result;
end;
$$;

-- Commit a server-computed snapshot (undo/reset) with compare-and-swap.
-- As with apply, the broker re-checks membership just before this call and
-- passes p->>'role_version'; a payload without it is refused.
create or replace function {{schema}}.contour_commit_snapshot(p jsonb) returns jsonb
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_tenant text := p->>'tenant_id';
  v_app text := p->>'app_id';
  v_subject text := p->>'subject_id';
  v_surface text := p->>'surface_id';
  v_op text := p->>'operation';
  v_key text := p->>'idempotency_key';
  v_req_hash text := p->>'request_hash';
  v_idem {{schema}}.idempotency_keys;
  v_view {{schema}}.user_views;
  v_new_rev integer;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if v_op not in ('undo', 'reset') then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'INVALID_INPUT');
  end if;
  select * into v_idem from {{schema}}.idempotency_keys
  where tenant_id = v_tenant and app_id = v_app and subject_id = v_subject and surface_id = v_surface
    and operation = v_op and key = v_key;
  if found then
    if v_idem.request_hash = v_req_hash then
      return v_idem.response || jsonb_build_object('replayed', true);
    end if;
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT');
  end if;

  if nullif(p->>'role_version', '') is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'FORBIDDEN');
  end if;

  v_view := {{schema}}.contour_lock_view(v_tenant, v_app, v_subject, v_surface, p->'default_config', p->>'default_hash',
                                         p->>'manifest_version', p->>'policy_version');
  if v_view.revision <> (p->>'expected_revision')::int then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'STALE_REVISION', 'currentRevision', v_view.revision);
  end if;

  v_new_rev := v_view.revision + 1;
  update {{schema}}.user_views set revision = v_new_rev, parent_revision = (p->>'parent_revision')::int,
    config = p->'config', config_hash = p->>'config_hash', manifest_version = p->>'manifest_version',
    policy_version = p->>'policy_version', updated_at = now()
  where tenant_id = v_tenant and app_id = v_app and subject_id = v_subject and surface_id = v_surface;
  insert into {{schema}}.view_history(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, revision, parent_revision, source,
    manifest_version, policy_version, config, config_hash)
  values (v_tenant, v_app, v_subject, v_surface, v_new_rev, (p->>'parent_revision')::int, v_op,
    p->>'manifest_version', p->>'policy_version', p->'config', p->>'config_hash');
  insert into {{schema}}.audit_events(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, kind, ref, detail)
  values (v_tenant, v_app, v_subject, v_surface, 'view_' || v_op, v_new_rev::text,
    jsonb_build_object('revision', v_new_rev, 'restoredFrom', p->>'restored_from', 'configHash', p->>'config_hash'));
  delete from {{schema}}.view_history h
  where h.tenant_id = v_tenant and h.app_id = v_app and h.subject_id = v_subject and h.surface_id = v_surface
    and h.revision <= v_new_rev - coalesce((p->>'history_limit')::int, 20);

  v_result := jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'revision', v_new_rev, 'configHash', p->>'config_hash');

-- Grant exactly one credit for a verified, paid Checkout Session. Dedupes
-- Stripe event IDs and the order/session grant.
create or replace function {{schema}}.contour_grant_credit(p jsonb) returns jsonb
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_order {{schema}}.billing_orders;
  v_credit_id uuid;
  v_inserted integer;
begin

  get diagnostics v_inserted = row_count;
  if v_inserted = 0 then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'result', 'duplicate_event');
  end if;

  select * into v_order from {{schema}}.billing_orders where id = (p->>'order_id')::uuid for update;
  if not found then
    update {{schema}}.stripe_events set result = 'unknown_order' where event_id = p->>'event_id';

  values (v_order.tenant_id, v_order.app_id, v_order.subject_id, v_order.id)
  returning id into v_credit_id;

  values (v_credit_id, v_order.tenant_id, v_order.app_id, v_order.subject_id, 'grant', v_order.id, p->>'event_id');

returns boolean

set search_path = ''
as $$
declare

  v_count integer;
begin

  on conflict (bucket, window_start) do update set count = {{schema}}.rate_limits.count + 1
  returning count into v_count;

end;
$$;

language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare

begin

  where code_hash = p_code_hash and used_at is null and expires_at > now()

end;
$$;

  p_subject text, p_tenant text, p_app text, p_client text, p_scopes text[], p_surfaces text[]
) returns {{schema}}.oauth_grants
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare

begin

        revoked_at = null,

end;
$$;

language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_expired integer;
  v_decisions integer;
  v_usage integer;
  v_released integer;
  v_rate integer;
begin

  where status = 'READY' and expires_at <= now();
  get diagnostics v_expired = row_count;

  delete from {{schema}}.decision_events where created_at < now() - interval '30 days';
  get diagnostics v_decisions = row_count;
  delete from {{schema}}.usage_events where created_at < now() - interval '30 days';
  get diagnostics v_usage = row_count;
  delete from {{schema}}.rate_limits where window_start < now() - interval '1 day';
  get diagnostics v_rate = row_count;

    select s.id, s.tenant_id, s.app_id, s.subject_id, 'release' from stale s
    returning 1

  select count(*) into v_released from led;

  return jsonb_build_object('expiredProposals', v_expired, 'deletedDecisions', v_decisions,

end;
$$;

# Contour discovery: Northwind Support

Produced by `node .claude/skills/contour-setup/scripts/discover.mjs .` plus a source read. No secrets are copied here.

## App root and framework

| Item | Finding |
| --- | --- |
| App root | `apps/northwind` (pnpm workspace member of `contour-demo`) |
| Framework | Next.js 16.3.8, App Router, `src/app` |
| React | 19.2.8 |
| Language | TypeScript, strict, `@/*` maps to `src/*` |
| Styling | Plain CSS (`src/app/globals.css`, `src/components/desk/desk.css`), Tailwind 4 PostCSS present |
| Package manager | pnpm (workspace), scripts: `dev` (port 3200), `build`, `lint`, `test` (vitest), `typecheck` |
| Path mapping | Skill paths `src/app` and `src/contour` used as-is |

## Authentication

| Item | Finding |
| --- | --- |
| Session | `src/lib/session.ts` `getSession()` verifies the HMAC-SHA256 signed `nw_session` cookie (`src/lib/auth.ts` `verifySession`), then reloads the user's current `role` and `team` from `northwind.users` |
| Session shape | `Session { userId, email, name, role: "agent" \| "lead" \| "admin", team }` |
| Session ID | None in the payload. A SHA-256 of the verified cookie is a stable per-sign-in identifier |
| Role version | None. `northwind.users` has no version column |
| Suspension | None. Deleting the user row is the only way to remove access |
| Page guard | `requireSession()` redirects to `/login` |
| Route guard | `src/app/api/_shared.ts` `isSameOrigin()` (Origin and `sec-fetch-site`) on every mutation |
| Login | `/login`, `POST /api/auth/login`; logout `POST /api/auth/logout` |
| Database client | `src/lib/db.ts` `getDb()` returns a service-role client already scoped with `.schema("northwind")` |

## Candidate route

`/desk` (`src/app/(workspace)/desk/page.tsx`) is the only candidate. It renders, in DOM order:

1. `SlaAlerts` (full width, above the layout)
2. `.desk-primary`: toolbar (URL filter tabs `all/open/pending`, density form) then `TicketQueue`
3. `.desk-bottom`: `KnowledgeBase` (+ guided/collapsed link) and `CustomerTimeline`
4. `aside.desk-secondary` "Service insights": `CsatTrend` and `WorkloadPanel`

URL query state: `filter`, `density`, `view`, `range`, `kb`, `limit`, `saved`, `error`.

## Component and variant map

| Component | File | Data prop | Closed presentation props | Other props |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SlaAlerts | `src/components/desk/SlaAlerts.tsx` | `breaches: SlaBreach[]` | `variant: banner \| expanded` | loading, error, className |
| TicketQueue | `src/components/desk/TicketQueue.tsx` (client) | `tickets: Ticket[]` | `variant: list \| cards`, `density: comfortable \| compact` | `currentUserId`, `now`; Assign to me and Reply actions; local reply draft state |
| CsatTrend | `src/components/desk/CsatTrend.tsx` | `data: CsatPoint[]` | `presentation: chart \| summary`, `range: 7d \| 30d` | `periodHrefs` |
| WorkloadPanel | `src/components/desk/WorkloadPanel.tsx` | `data: Workload[]` | `density: comfortable \| compact` | |
| KnowledgeBase | `src/components/desk/KnowledgeBase.tsx` | `articles: KbArticle[]` | `mode: guided \| collapsed` | |
| CustomerTimeline | `src/components/desk/CustomerTimeline.tsx` | `events: CustomerEvent[]` | `density: comfortable \| compact` | `now` |

Every component already has loading, error, and empty states through `PanelState`.

## Data functions and field types

All take the verified `Session` first and scope through `scopedQuery` (`src/data/shared.ts`): agents and leads see `team = session.team`, admins see all teams.

| Function | Returns | Fields |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `getTickets(session, { filter, limit })` | `Ticket[]` | id, number, subject, description, status, priority, team, customerId, customerName, customerCompany, assigneeId, assigneeName, createdAt, updatedAt, dueAt, channel |
| `getSlaBreaches(session)` | `SlaBreach[]` | ticketId, ticketNumber, subject, customerName, team, dueAt, minutesOverdue |
| `getCsatTrend(session, { range })` | `CsatPoint[]` | date, score, responses |
| `getWorkload(session)` | `Workload[]` | userId, name, team, open, pending, capacity |
| `getKbArticles(session, { topic })` | `KbArticle[]` | id, title, summary, body, topic, team, readMinutes, updatedAt |
| `getCustomerTimeline(session, { limit, customerId })` | `CustomerEvent[]` | id, customerId, customerName, customerCompany, ticketId, ticketNumber, team, kind (`reply \| opened \| resolved \| note`), description, createdAt |
| `getCustomers`, `getCustomer` | `Customer[]` | includes customer `email` (not used on `/desk`) |

Mutations (never called by readers): `assignTicket`, `replyToTicket`, `saveUserSettings`.

## Permission rules

- Every data function calls `assertSession` and `scopedQuery`; ticket mutations repeat the team scope in the UPDATE.
- `/admin` renders only for `role === "admin"`.
- `northwind` schema: RLS on, service_role only.

## Fixed chrome (stays outside the adaptive region)

- `WorkspaceNav` (`src/components/workspace-nav.tsx`): main navigation, account menu, Admin link
- Workspace footer (`src/app/(workspace)/layout.tsx`)
- `/admin`, `/settings`, `/customers`, `/reports` pages
- Billing: Northwind has no billing page or component

## Unresolved SDK requirements

1. The broker emits `previewUrl` as `${appUrl}/preview/:id`, not `/contour/preview/:id`. A same-origin compatibility redirect is needed.
2. `proposeView` reserves a prepaid adaptation credit from `<schema>.credits`. Northwind has no billing flow, so proposals return `PAYMENT_REQUIRED` (with a `/billing` URL that Northwind does not have) until credits are granted.
3. The SDK host route table has a per-grant revoke (`POST /api/host/agents/[grantId]/revoke`) but no revoke-all route; the host must expose `revokeAllGrantsForApp` itself.
4. `ViewPreview` and `ComponentBoundary` use Tailwind utility class names and `hc`/`btn` classes from the ops demo; Northwind needs host CSS for these.
5. No Cloud registration client or device flow exists in the SDK.
6. `northwind.users` needs a `role_version` counter for `Membership.roleVersion`.

- `/admin` renders only for `role === "admin"`.

- `WorkspaceNav` (`src/components/workspace-nav.tsx`): main navigation, account menu, Admin link
- Workspace footer (`src/app/(workspace)/layout.tsx`)

- Billing: Northwind has no billing page or component

1. The broker emits `previewUrl` as `${appUrl}/preview/:id`, not `/contour/preview/:id`. A same-origin compatibility redirect is needed.

5. No Cloud registration client or device flow exists in the SDK.

⏸ CHECKPOINT 3: agent access

| Decision | Proposed default | Your answer (quoted) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Identity | The existing verified `nw_session` (`getSession()`: HMAC and expiry check, then a live reload of role and team). No new login system. `HostUser`: `subjectId` = `northwind.users.id`; `sessionId` = SHA-256 of the verified cookie (never the raw cookie); `tenantId` = `"northwind"` (the company, not the support team); `role`, `roleVersion` from the live `users` row; `displayName`, `email` from the session. A signed-in user without a valid row gets `FORBIDDEN`, never a login loop | "Preserve the host's authentication." |
| Allowed roles | `agent`, `lead`, `admin`. `Membership.dataAccess` is true only for these three. `status` is `active` while the user row exists; deleting the row removes membership (Northwind has no suspension column) | "Agent roles: agent, lead, and admin." |
| Kill switch | Agents ENABLED; admin kill switch available and off. Turning it on DISABLES agents. Stored in `northwind_contour.tenant_app_settings`. Missing row, wrong company/app, or a database error means disabled. `/admin` shows an "Allow agent access" checkbox for admins only, posting to `/api/contour-admin/agent-access` with same-origin and CSRF checks | "Agents ENABLED; kill switch available and off. Turning the kill switch on DISABLES agents." |
| Revocation | Every agent call reloads the user row and checks role, `role_version`, the kill switch, and grant revision. Readers rebuild the `Session` with the **current** team and refuse a version mismatch. Changing a role or team bumps `role_version` in a trigger, so open proposals become invalid and the next call sees the new scope. Settings lists your agent connections, each with Disconnect (SDK `POST /api/host/agents/[grantId]/revoke`). Admin gets "Disconnect all agents" (`revokeAllGrantsForApp`, same-origin and CSRF) | Not named. Needs your answer |
| Contour schema | Dedicated `northwind_contour`, never `public` or `northwind`. `server.ts` uses `schema: "northwind_contour"`. Command (after approval): `node node_modules/@contour/sdk/bin/contour-migrate.mjs --schema northwind_contour --apply --workdir ../ops-demo`. Exact SQL below (869 lines, SHA-256 `6767f9fe6a07b4196772fd75b4d5bf848571af3499cc3cb60a34092f28470e03`) | "Contour tables go in the dedicated northwind_contour schema, never public or northwind". Your message says no SQL is approved up front |

The exact rollback is `supabase/contour-host.down.sql`. Both are shown in full below. Order: contour-migrate first, then the host SQL. **Contour migration SQL, target schema `northwind_contour`** (printed with `contour-migrate --schema northwind_contour`, not applied):

```sql
-- Contour schema-scoped install for northwind_contour.
-- Rendered by `contour-migrate --schema northwind_contour`. Do not edit the output by hand.
--
-- Built from apps/ops-demo/supabase/migrations (core, oauth_extras, retention,
-- review_hardening) with these changes for a generic company install:
--  * Every object lives in northwind_contour. Nothing touches the public schema.
--  * Company tables (tenants, apps, membership rows, demo data) are not
--    created. Membership comes from the host's identity.getMembership adapter.
--  * subject_id is text with no FK to the auth schema (company IDs are not
--    always Supabase auth UUIDs).
--  * contour_apply_proposal / contour_commit_snapshot take the caller's fresh
--    role version as p->>'role_version' instead of reading a membership row.
--  * Service-role only: RLS is enabled on every table with no policies, and
--    anon/authenticated hold no privileges on anything in northwind_contour.
--  * Idempotent: safe to re-run (if not exists, create or replace, guarded
--    constraint adds).

begin;

create schema if not exists northwind_contour;

-- ------------------------------------------------------------ settings
create table if not exists northwind_contour.tenant_app_settings (
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  agent_access_enabled boolean not null default true,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_by text,
  primary key (tenant_id, app_id)
);

create table if not exists northwind_contour.surface_manifests (
  app_id text not null,
  surface_id text not null,
  manifest_version text not null,
  policy_version text not null,
  manifest_hash text not null,
  manifest jsonb not null,
  deployed_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (app_id, surface_id, manifest_version, policy_version)
);

-- --------------------------------------------------------- user state
create table if not exists northwind_contour.user_preferences (
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text not null,
  surface_id text not null,
  expertise text check (expertise in ('beginner', 'expert')),
  density text check (density in ('comfortable', 'compact')),
  help text not null default 'auto' check (help in ('auto', 'show', 'hide')),
  pins jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb check (jsonb_typeof(pins) = 'array' and jsonb_array_length(pins) <= 12),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id)
);

create table if not exists northwind_contour.user_views (
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text not null,
  surface_id text not null,
  revision integer not null check (revision >= 0),
  parent_revision integer,
  manifest_version text not null,
  policy_version text not null,
  config jsonb not null,
  config_hash text not null,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id)
);

create table if not exists northwind_contour.view_history (
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text not null,
  surface_id text not null,
  revision integer not null,
  parent_revision integer,
  source text not null check (source in ('default', 'proposal', 'undo', 'reset')),
  proposal_id uuid,
  manifest_version text not null,
  policy_version text not null,
  config jsonb not null,
  config_hash text not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, revision)
);

create table if not exists northwind_contour.proposals (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text not null,
  surface_id text not null,
  client_id text not null,
  base_revision integer not null,
  manifest_version text not null,
  policy_version text not null,
  role_version integer not null,
  config jsonb not null,
  config_hash text not null,
  candidate_id text not null,
  status text not null check (status in ('READY', 'APPLIED', 'REJECTED', 'EXPIRED', 'STALE', 'INVALID')),
  status_reason text,
  task text not null,
  expertise text not null,
  preferences jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  changes jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  rationale text not null default '',
  decision_id uuid not null,
  job_id uuid not null unique,
  request_id text not null check (length(request_id) between 8 and 128),
  request_hash text not null,
  expires_at timestamptz not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  applied_at timestamptz,
  applied_revision integer,
  unique (tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, request_id)
);
create index if not exists proposals_owner_idx on northwind_contour.proposals(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, created_at desc);

create table if not exists northwind_contour.approvals (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  proposal_id uuid not null unique references northwind_contour.proposals(id),
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text not null,
  surface_id text not null,
  config_hash text not null,
  base_revision integer not null,
  proposal_expires_at timestamptz not null,
  approved_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  idempotency_key text not null,
  channel text not null check (channel = 'host')
);

create table if not exists northwind_contour.idempotency_keys (
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text not null,
  surface_id text not null,
  operation text not null,
  key text not null check (length(key) between 8 and 128),
  request_hash text not null,
  response jsonb not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, operation, key)
);

-- ------------------------------------------------------- observability
create table if not exists northwind_contour.decision_events (
  id uuid primary key,
  job_id uuid not null,
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text not null,
  surface_id text not null,
  client_id text not null,
  channel text not null,
  manifest_version text not null,
  policy_version text not null,
  model_version text,
  candidate_ids text[] not null default '{}',
  candidate_hashes jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  selected_id text,
  distribution jsonb,
  confidence double precision,
  confidence_floor double precision,
  inputs jsonb not null,
  assumptions jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  validation text not null,
  validation_rules jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb,
  outcome text not null,
  outcome_reason text,
  provider_status text not null,
  provider_latency_ms integer,
  total_latency_ms integer,
  input_tokens integer,
  output_tokens integer,
  provider_cost numeric(12, 8),
  currency text,
  rationale text,
  proposal_id uuid,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists decision_events_owner_idx on northwind_contour.decision_events(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, created_at desc);
create index if not exists decision_events_app_idx on northwind_contour.decision_events(tenant_id, app_id, created_at desc);

create table if not exists northwind_contour.usage_events (
  job_id uuid primary key,
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text not null,
  provider text not null,
  model_version text,
  provider_usage jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  provider_cost numeric(12, 8),
  currency text,
  status text not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists northwind_contour.audit_events (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text,
  surface_id text,
  kind text not null,
  ref text,
  detail jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
-- The schema may already own an audit_events table (Cloud's registry log has
-- contour_user/project_id columns). Add the Contour columns, nullable, so both
-- writers share one table. No-op on a table created just above.
alter table northwind_contour.audit_events
  add column if not exists tenant_id text,
  add column if not exists app_id text,
  add column if not exists subject_id text,
  add column if not exists surface_id text,
  add column if not exists kind text,
  add column if not exists ref text,
  add column if not exists detail jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  add column if not exists created_at timestamptz not null default now();
create index if not exists audit_events_app_idx on northwind_contour.audit_events(tenant_id, app_id, created_at desc);

-- --------------------------------------------------------------- billing
create table if not exists northwind_contour.billing_orders (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text not null,
  status text not null default 'pending' check (status in ('pending', 'granted', 'canceled', 'rejected')),
  credits integer not null default 1 check (credits = 1),
  amount integer not null,
  currency text not null,
  price_id text not null,
  stripe_session_id text unique,
  stripe_payment_intent text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  granted_at timestamptz
);

create table if not exists northwind_contour.stripe_events (
  event_id text primary key,
  type text not null,
  livemode boolean not null,
  order_id uuid,
  result text not null,
  received_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists northwind_contour.credits (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text not null,
  order_id uuid not null unique references northwind_contour.billing_orders(id),
  status text not null default 'available' check (status in ('available', 'reserved', 'consumed')),
  job_id uuid unique,
  reserved_at timestamptz,
  consumed_at timestamptz,
  proposal_id uuid,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists credits_owner_idx on northwind_contour.credits(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, status);

create table if not exists northwind_contour.credit_ledger (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  credit_id uuid not null references northwind_contour.credits(id),
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  subject_id text not null,
  kind text not null check (kind in ('grant', 'reserve', 'consume', 'release')),
  job_id uuid,
  order_id uuid,
  stripe_event_id text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create unique index if not exists credit_ledger_consume_once on northwind_contour.credit_ledger(credit_id) where kind = 'consume';
create unique index if not exists credit_ledger_grant_once on northwind_contour.credit_ledger(credit_id) where kind = 'grant';

-- ------------------------------------------------------------ OAuth / MCP
create table if not exists northwind_contour.oauth_clients (
  client_id text primary key check (length(client_id) between 8 and 512),
  kind text not null check (kind in ('dcr', 'cimd', 'preregistered')),
  client_name text not null,
  redirect_uris text[] not null check (array_length(redirect_uris, 1) between 1 and 10),
  metadata jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  refreshed_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists northwind_contour.oauth_grants (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  subject_id text not null,
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  client_id text not null references northwind_contour.oauth_clients(client_id) on delete cascade,
  scopes text[] not null,
  surfaces text[] not null,
  grant_revision integer not null default 1,
  revoked_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (subject_id, tenant_id, app_id, client_id)
);
create index if not exists oauth_grants_tenant_app_idx on northwind_contour.oauth_grants(tenant_id, app_id);
create index if not exists oauth_grants_subject_idx on northwind_contour.oauth_grants(subject_id, tenant_id, app_id);

-- Codes are bound to the grant and grant revision they were issued under, so
-- a code minted before a revoke or re-consent cannot be redeemed.
create table if not exists northwind_contour.oauth_codes (
  code_hash text primary key,
  client_id text not null references northwind_contour.oauth_clients(client_id) on delete cascade,
  subject_id text not null,
  tenant_id text not null,
  app_id text not null,
  scopes text[] not null,
  surfaces text[] not null,
  resource text not null,
  redirect_uri text not null,
  code_challenge text not null,
  expires_at timestamptz not null,
  used_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  grant_id uuid not null references northwind_contour.oauth_grants(id) on delete cascade,
  grant_revision integer not null
);
create index if not exists oauth_codes_expires_idx on northwind_contour.oauth_codes(expires_at);

create table if not exists northwind_contour.oauth_tokens (
  token_hash text primary key,
  grant_id uuid not null references northwind_contour.oauth_grants(id) on delete cascade,
  kind text not null check (kind in ('access', 'refresh')),
  resource text not null,
  scopes text[] not null,
  grant_revision integer not null,
  expires_at timestamptz not null,
  revoked_at timestamptz,
  replaced_by text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists oauth_tokens_grant_idx on northwind_contour.oauth_tokens(grant_id);

create table if not exists northwind_contour.rate_limits (
  bucket text not null,
  window_start timestamptz not null,
  count integer not null default 0,
  primary key (bucket, window_start)
);

-- Defence in depth: OAuth rows can never carry a scope outside the agent set
-- (never the commit scope), regardless of application code.
do $$
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from pg_constraint
                 where conrelid = 'northwind_contour.oauth_grants'::regclass and conname = 'oauth_grants_agent_scopes_only') then
    alter table northwind_contour.oauth_grants add constraint oauth_grants_agent_scopes_only
      check (scopes <@ array['view:read', 'data:read', 'view:propose']::text[]);
  end if;
  if not exists (select 1 from pg_constraint
                 where conrelid = 'northwind_contour.oauth_codes'::regclass and conname = 'oauth_codes_agent_scopes_only') then
    alter table northwind_contour.oauth_codes add constraint oauth_codes_agent_scopes_only
      check (scopes <@ array['view:read', 'data:read', 'view:propose']::text[]);
  end if;
  if not exists (select 1 from pg_constraint
                 where conrelid = 'northwind_contour.oauth_tokens'::regclass and conname = 'oauth_tokens_agent_scopes_only') then
    alter table northwind_contour.oauth_tokens add constraint oauth_tokens_agent_scopes_only
      check (scopes <@ array['view:read', 'data:read', 'view:propose']::text[]);
  end if;
end $$;

-- -------------------------------------------------------------------- RLS
-- Service-role only: RLS on, no policies.
alter table northwind_contour.tenant_app_settings enable row level security;
alter table northwind_contour.surface_manifests enable row level security;
alter table northwind_contour.user_preferences enable row level security;
alter table northwind_contour.user_views enable row level security;
alter table northwind_contour.view_history enable row level security;
alter table northwind_contour.proposals enable row level security;
alter table northwind_contour.approvals enable row level security;
alter table northwind_contour.idempotency_keys enable row level security;
alter table northwind_contour.decision_events enable row level security;

alter table northwind_contour.audit_events enable row level security;

-- ===================================================== transactional RPCs
-- SECURITY INVOKER, fixed empty search_path, executable only by service_role.
-- They return jsonb {ok, code, ...} rather than raising for business outcomes
-- so that status transitions (e.g. STALE) persist.

-- Reserve one available credit for an adaptation job. Releases stale
-- reservations (older than 10 minutes, no proposal) first.
create or replace function northwind_contour.contour_reserve_credit(
  p_tenant text, p_app text, p_subject text, p_job uuid
) returns jsonb
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_credit northwind_contour.credits;
begin
  with stale as (
    update northwind_contour.credits c set status = 'available', job_id = null, reserved_at = null
    where c.tenant_id = p_tenant and c.app_id = p_app and c.subject_id = p_subject
      and c.status = 'reserved' and c.reserved_at < now() - interval '10 minutes'
    returning c.*
  )
  insert into northwind_contour.credit_ledger(credit_id, tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, kind, job_id)
  select s.id, s.tenant_id, s.app_id, s.subject_id, 'release', null from stale s;

  -- Idempotent: an existing reservation for this job is returned as-is.
  select * into v_credit from northwind_contour.credits where job_id = p_job;
  if found then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'creditId', v_credit.id, 'status', v_credit.status);
  end if;

  select * into v_credit from northwind_contour.credits c
  where c.tenant_id = p_tenant and c.app_id = p_app and c.subject_id = p_subject and c.status = 'available'
  order by c.created_at
  for update skip locked
  limit 1;
  if not found then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'PAYMENT_REQUIRED');
  end if;

  update northwind_contour.credits set status = 'reserved', job_id = p_job, reserved_at = now() where id = v_credit.id;
  insert into northwind_contour.credit_ledger(credit_id, tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, kind, job_id)
  values (v_credit.id, p_tenant, p_app, p_subject, 'reserve', p_job);
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'creditId', v_credit.id, 'status', 'reserved');
end;
$$;

create or replace function northwind_contour.contour_release_credit(p_job uuid) returns jsonb
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_credit northwind_contour.credits;
begin
  select * into v_credit from northwind_contour.credits where job_id = p_job for update;
  if not found or v_credit.status <> 'reserved' then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'released', false);
  end if;
  update northwind_contour.credits set status = 'available', job_id = null, reserved_at = null where id = v_credit.id;
  insert into northwind_contour.credit_ledger(credit_id, tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, kind, job_id)
  values (v_credit.id, v_credit.tenant_id, v_credit.app_id, v_credit.subject_id, 'release', p_job);
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'released', true);
end;
$$;

-- Persist a READY proposal and consume the job's reserved credit in one
-- transaction. Idempotent per (owner, request_id): identical payload returns
-- the existing proposal, a different payload is rejected.
create or replace function northwind_contour.contour_create_proposal(p jsonb) returns jsonb
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_existing northwind_contour.proposals;
  v_credit northwind_contour.credits;
  v_id uuid;
  v_job uuid := (p->>'job_id')::uuid;
  v_subject text := p->>'subject_id';
begin
  select * into v_existing from northwind_contour.proposals
  where tenant_id = p->>'tenant_id' and app_id = p->>'app_id' and subject_id = v_subject
    and surface_id = p->>'surface_id' and request_id = p->>'request_id';
  if found then
    if v_existing.request_hash = p->>'request_hash' then
      return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'replayed', true, 'proposalId', v_existing.id, 'jobId', v_existing.job_id);
    end if;
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT');
  end if;

  select * into v_credit from northwind_contour.credits where job_id = v_job for update;
  if not found or v_credit.status <> 'reserved'
     or v_credit.subject_id <> v_subject or v_credit.tenant_id <> p->>'tenant_id' or v_credit.app_id <> p->>'app_id' then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'PAYMENT_REQUIRED');
  end if;

  insert into northwind_contour.proposals(
    tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, client_id, base_revision, manifest_version, policy_version,
    role_version, config, config_hash, candidate_id, status, task, expertise, preferences, changes, rationale,
    decision_id, job_id, request_id, request_hash, expires_at
  ) values (
    p->>'tenant_id', p->>'app_id', v_subject, p->>'surface_id', p->>'client_id', (p->>'base_revision')::int,
    p->>'manifest_version', p->>'policy_version', (p->>'role_version')::int, p->'config', p->>'config_hash',
    p->>'candidate_id', 'READY', p->>'task', p->>'expertise', coalesce(p->'preferences', '{}'::jsonb),
    coalesce(p->'changes', '[]'::jsonb), coalesce(p->>'rationale', ''), (p->>'decision_id')::uuid, v_job,
    p->>'request_id', p->>'request_hash', (p->>'expires_at')::timestamptz
  ) returning id into v_id;

  update northwind_contour.credits set status = 'consumed', consumed_at = now(), proposal_id = v_id where id = v_credit.id;
  insert into northwind_contour.credit_ledger(credit_id, tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, kind, job_id)
  values (v_credit.id, v_credit.tenant_id, v_credit.app_id, v_credit.subject_id, 'consume', v_job);

  insert into northwind_contour.audit_events(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, kind, ref, detail)
  values (p->>'tenant_id', p->>'app_id', v_subject, p->>'surface_id', 'proposal_created', v_id::text,
          jsonb_build_object('jobId', v_job, 'clientId', p->>'client_id', 'candidateId', p->>'candidate_id'));
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'replayed', false, 'proposalId', v_id, 'jobId', v_job, 'creditId', v_credit.id);
end;
$$;

-- Internal: lock (creating if needed) the owner's active view row.
create or replace function northwind_contour.contour_lock_view(
  p_tenant text, p_app text, p_subject text, p_surface text,
  p_default_config jsonb, p_default_hash text, p_manifest_version text, p_policy_version text
) returns northwind_contour.user_views
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_view northwind_contour.user_views;
begin
  insert into northwind_contour.user_views(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, revision, parent_revision,
    manifest_version, policy_version, config, config_hash)
  values (p_tenant, p_app, p_subject, p_surface, 0, null, p_manifest_version, p_policy_version, p_default_config, p_default_hash)
  on conflict do nothing;
  insert into northwind_contour.view_history(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, revision, parent_revision, source,
    manifest_version, policy_version, config, config_hash)
  values (p_tenant, p_app, p_subject, p_surface, 0, null, 'default', p_manifest_version, p_policy_version, p_default_config, p_default_hash)
  on conflict do nothing;
  select * into v_view from northwind_contour.user_views
  where tenant_id = p_tenant and app_id = p_app and subject_id = p_subject and surface_id = p_surface
  for update;
  return v_view;
end;
$$;

-- Approve + apply a stored proposal atomically (host-only flow).
-- Membership is the host's: the broker re-checks it through
-- identity.getMembership immediately before this call and passes the fresh
-- role version as p->>'role_version'. A missing role version is refused.
create or replace function northwind_contour.contour_apply_proposal(p jsonb) returns jsonb
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_tenant text := p->>'tenant_id';
  v_app text := p->>'app_id';
  v_subject text := p->>'subject_id';
  v_surface text := p->>'surface_id';
  v_key text := p->>'idempotency_key';
  v_req_hash text := p->>'request_hash';
  v_role_version integer := nullif(p->>'role_version', '')::int;
  v_idem northwind_contour.idempotency_keys;
  v_prop northwind_contour.proposals;
  v_view northwind_contour.user_views;
  v_new_rev integer;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_idem from northwind_contour.idempotency_keys
  where tenant_id = v_tenant and app_id = v_app and subject_id = v_subject and surface_id = v_surface
    and operation = 'apply' and key = v_key;
  if found then
    if v_idem.request_hash = v_req_hash then
      return v_idem.response || jsonb_build_object('replayed', true);
    end if;
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT');
  end if;

  select * into v_prop from northwind_contour.proposals where id = (p->>'proposal_id')::uuid for update;
  -- Wrong owner is indistinguishable from not found.
  if not found or v_prop.tenant_id <> v_tenant or v_prop.app_id <> v_app
     or v_prop.subject_id <> v_subject or v_prop.surface_id <> v_surface then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'NOT_FOUND');
  end if;
  if v_prop.status <> 'READY' then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'PROPOSAL_NOT_READY', 'status', v_prop.status);
  end if;
  if v_prop.expires_at <= now() then
    update northwind_contour.proposals set status = 'EXPIRED', status_reason = 'expired before approval' where id = v_prop.id;
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'EXPIRED_PROPOSAL');
  end if;
  if v_prop.config_hash <> p->>'config_hash' then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'HASH_MISMATCH');
  end if;

  if v_role_version is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'FORBIDDEN');
  end if;
  if v_prop.manifest_version <> p->>'manifest_version' or v_prop.policy_version <> p->>'policy_version'
     or v_prop.role_version <> v_role_version then
    update northwind_contour.proposals set status = 'INVALID', status_reason = 'manifest, policy or role changed' where id = v_prop.id;
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'INCOMPATIBLE_MANIFEST');
  end if;

  v_view := northwind_contour.contour_lock_view(v_tenant, v_app, v_subject, v_surface, p->'default_config', p->>'default_hash',
                                         p->>'manifest_version', p->>'policy_version');
  if v_view.revision <> v_prop.base_revision then
    update northwind_contour.proposals set status = 'STALE', status_reason = 'base revision changed' where id = v_prop.id;
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'STALE_REVISION', 'currentRevision', v_view.revision);
  end if;

  v_new_rev := v_view.revision + 1;
  update northwind_contour.user_views set revision = v_new_rev, parent_revision = v_view.revision, config = v_prop.config,
    config_hash = v_prop.config_hash, manifest_version = v_prop.manifest_version, policy_version = v_prop.policy_version,
    updated_at = now()
  where tenant_id = v_tenant and app_id = v_app and subject_id = v_subject and surface_id = v_surface;
  insert into northwind_contour.view_history(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, revision, parent_revision, source,
    proposal_id, manifest_version, policy_version, config, config_hash)
  values (v_tenant, v_app, v_subject, v_surface, v_new_rev, v_view.revision, 'proposal', v_prop.id,
    v_prop.manifest_version, v_prop.policy_version, v_prop.config, v_prop.config_hash);
  insert into northwind_contour.approvals(proposal_id, tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, config_hash, base_revision,
    proposal_expires_at, idempotency_key, channel)
  values (v_prop.id, v_tenant, v_app, v_subject, v_surface, v_prop.config_hash, v_prop.base_revision,
    v_prop.expires_at, v_key, 'host');
  update northwind_contour.proposals set status = 'APPLIED', applied_at = now(), applied_revision = v_new_rev where id = v_prop.id;
  insert into northwind_contour.audit_events(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, kind, ref, detail)
  values (v_tenant, v_app, v_subject, v_surface, 'view_committed', v_prop.id::text,
    jsonb_build_object('revision', v_new_rev, 'jobId', v_prop.job_id, 'configHash', v_prop.config_hash));

  delete from northwind_contour.view_history h
  where h.tenant_id = v_tenant and h.app_id = v_app and h.subject_id = v_subject and h.surface_id = v_surface
    and h.revision <= v_new_rev - coalesce((p->>'history_limit')::int, 20);

  v_result := jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'revision', v_new_rev, 'proposalId', v_prop.id, 'configHash', v_prop.config_hash);
  insert into northwind_contour.idempotency_keys(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, operation, key, request_hash, response)
  values (v_tenant, v_app, v_subject, v_surface, 'apply', v_key, v_req_hash, v_result);
  return v_result;
end;
$$;

-- Commit a server-computed snapshot (undo/reset) with compare-and-swap.
-- As with apply, the broker re-checks membership just before this call and
-- passes p->>'role_version'; a payload without it is refused.
create or replace function northwind_contour.contour_commit_snapshot(p jsonb) returns jsonb
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_tenant text := p->>'tenant_id';
  v_app text := p->>'app_id';
  v_subject text := p->>'subject_id';
  v_surface text := p->>'surface_id';
  v_op text := p->>'operation';
  v_key text := p->>'idempotency_key';
  v_req_hash text := p->>'request_hash';
  v_idem northwind_contour.idempotency_keys;
  v_view northwind_contour.user_views;
  v_new_rev integer;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if v_op not in ('undo', 'reset') then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'INVALID_INPUT');
  end if;
  select * into v_idem from northwind_contour.idempotency_keys
  where tenant_id = v_tenant and app_id = v_app and subject_id = v_subject and surface_id = v_surface
    and operation = v_op and key = v_key;
  if found then
    if v_idem.request_hash = v_req_hash then
      return v_idem.response || jsonb_build_object('replayed', true);
    end if;
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT');
  end if;

  if nullif(p->>'role_version', '') is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'FORBIDDEN');
  end if;

  v_view := northwind_contour.contour_lock_view(v_tenant, v_app, v_subject, v_surface, p->'default_config', p->>'default_hash',
                                         p->>'manifest_version', p->>'policy_version');
  if v_view.revision <> (p->>'expected_revision')::int then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'code', 'STALE_REVISION', 'currentRevision', v_view.revision);
  end if;

  v_new_rev := v_view.revision + 1;
  update northwind_contour.user_views set revision = v_new_rev, parent_revision = (p->>'parent_revision')::int,
    config = p->'config', config_hash = p->>'config_hash', manifest_version = p->>'manifest_version',
    policy_version = p->>'policy_version', updated_at = now()
  where tenant_id = v_tenant and app_id = v_app and subject_id = v_subject and surface_id = v_surface;
  insert into northwind_contour.view_history(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, revision, parent_revision, source,
    manifest_version, policy_version, config, config_hash)
  values (v_tenant, v_app, v_subject, v_surface, v_new_rev, (p->>'parent_revision')::int, v_op,
    p->>'manifest_version', p->>'policy_version', p->'config', p->>'config_hash');
  insert into northwind_contour.audit_events(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, kind, ref, detail)
  values (v_tenant, v_app, v_subject, v_surface, 'view_' || v_op, v_new_rev::text,
    jsonb_build_object('revision', v_new_rev, 'restoredFrom', p->>'restored_from', 'configHash', p->>'config_hash'));
  delete from northwind_contour.view_history h
  where h.tenant_id = v_tenant and h.app_id = v_app and h.subject_id = v_subject and h.surface_id = v_surface
    and h.revision <= v_new_rev - coalesce((p->>'history_limit')::int, 20);

  v_result := jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'revision', v_new_rev, 'configHash', p->>'config_hash');
  insert into northwind_contour.idempotency_keys(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, surface_id, operation, key, request_hash, response)
  values (v_tenant, v_app, v_subject, v_surface, v_op, v_key, v_req_hash, v_result);
  return v_result;
end;
$$;

-- Grant exactly one credit for a verified, paid Checkout Session. Dedupes
-- Stripe event IDs and the order/session grant.
create or replace function northwind_contour.contour_grant_credit(p jsonb) returns jsonb
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_order northwind_contour.billing_orders;
  v_credit_id uuid;
  v_inserted integer;
begin
  insert into northwind_contour.stripe_events(event_id, type, livemode, order_id, result)
  values (p->>'event_id', p->>'event_type', (p->>'livemode')::boolean, (p->>'order_id')::uuid, 'processing')
  on conflict (event_id) do nothing;
  get diagnostics v_inserted = row_count;
  if v_inserted = 0 then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'result', 'duplicate_event');
  end if;

  select * into v_order from northwind_contour.billing_orders where id = (p->>'order_id')::uuid for update;
  if not found then
    update northwind_contour.stripe_events set result = 'unknown_order' where event_id = p->>'event_id';
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'result', 'unknown_order');
  end if;
  if v_order.stripe_session_id is distinct from p->>'session_id'
     or v_order.tenant_id <> p->>'tenant_id' or v_order.subject_id <> p->>'subject_id' or v_order.app_id <> p->>'app_id'
     or v_order.amount <> (p->>'amount')::int or v_order.currency <> p->>'currency' then
    update northwind_contour.stripe_events set result = 'order_mismatch' where event_id = p->>'event_id';
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'result', 'order_mismatch');
  end if;
  if v_order.status = 'granted' then
    update northwind_contour.stripe_events set result = 'already_granted' where event_id = p->>'event_id';
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'result', 'already_granted');
  end if;
  if v_order.status <> 'pending' then
    update northwind_contour.stripe_events set result = 'order_not_pending' where event_id = p->>'event_id';
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'result', 'order_not_pending');
  end if;

  insert into northwind_contour.credits(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, order_id)
  values (v_order.tenant_id, v_order.app_id, v_order.subject_id, v_order.id)
  returning id into v_credit_id;
  insert into northwind_contour.credit_ledger(credit_id, tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, kind, order_id, stripe_event_id)
  values (v_credit_id, v_order.tenant_id, v_order.app_id, v_order.subject_id, 'grant', v_order.id, p->>'event_id');
  update northwind_contour.billing_orders set status = 'granted', granted_at = now(), stripe_payment_intent = p->>'payment_intent'
  where id = v_order.id;
  update northwind_contour.stripe_events set result = 'granted' where event_id = p->>'event_id';
  insert into northwind_contour.audit_events(tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, kind, ref, detail)
  values (v_order.tenant_id, v_order.app_id, v_order.subject_id, 'credit_granted', v_order.id::text,
    jsonb_build_object('creditId', v_credit_id, 'eventId', p->>'event_id'));
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'result', 'granted', 'creditId', v_credit_id);
end;
$$;

-- Fixed-window rate limiter.
create or replace function northwind_contour.contour_rate_limit(p_bucket text, p_window_seconds integer, p_max integer)
returns boolean
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_start timestamptz := to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from now()) / p_window_seconds) * p_window_seconds);
  v_count integer;
begin
  insert into northwind_contour.rate_limits(bucket, window_start, count) values (p_bucket, v_start, 1)
  on conflict (bucket, window_start) do update set count = northwind_contour.rate_limits.count + 1
  returning count into v_count;
  return v_count <= p_max;
end;
$$;

-- Atomically redeem an OAuth authorization code (single use).
create or replace function northwind_contour.contour_redeem_code(p_code_hash text) returns northwind_contour.oauth_codes
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_code northwind_contour.oauth_codes;
begin
  update northwind_contour.oauth_codes set used_at = now()
  where code_hash = p_code_hash and used_at is null and expires_at > now()
  returning * into v_code;
  return v_code;
end;
$$;

-- (Re-)consent: insert or bump revision, clear revocation, replace scopes.
create or replace function northwind_contour.contour_upsert_grant(
  p_subject text, p_tenant text, p_app text, p_client text, p_scopes text[], p_surfaces text[]
) returns northwind_contour.oauth_grants
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_grant northwind_contour.oauth_grants;
begin
  insert into northwind_contour.oauth_grants(subject_id, tenant_id, app_id, client_id, scopes, surfaces)
  values (p_subject, p_tenant, p_app, p_client, p_scopes, p_surfaces)
  on conflict (subject_id, tenant_id, app_id, client_id) do update
    set scopes = excluded.scopes,
        surfaces = excluded.surfaces,
        grant_revision = northwind_contour.oauth_grants.grant_revision + 1,
        revoked_at = null,
        updated_at = now()
  returning * into v_grant;
  -- Tokens from earlier revisions are dead anyway (revision check); mark them
  -- revoked too so listings and introspection agree.
  update northwind_contour.oauth_tokens set revoked_at = now()
  where grant_id = v_grant.id and revoked_at is null and grant_revision < v_grant.grant_revision;
  return v_grant;
end;
$$;

-- Retention and reconciliation: expire unaccepted proposals after their TTL,
-- keep decision/usage metadata 30 days, and release stale credit reservations.
create or replace function northwind_contour.contour_retention() returns jsonb
language plpgsql
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_expired integer;
  v_decisions integer;
  v_usage integer;
  v_released integer;
  v_rate integer;
begin
  update northwind_contour.proposals set status = 'EXPIRED', status_reason = 'ttl elapsed'
  where status = 'READY' and expires_at <= now();
  get diagnostics v_expired = row_count;

  delete from northwind_contour.decision_events where created_at < now() - interval '30 days';
  get diagnostics v_decisions = row_count;
  delete from northwind_contour.usage_events where created_at < now() - interval '30 days';
  get diagnostics v_usage = row_count;
  delete from northwind_contour.rate_limits where window_start < now() - interval '1 day';
  get diagnostics v_rate = row_count;

  with stale as (
    update northwind_contour.credits c set status = 'available', job_id = null, reserved_at = null
    where c.status = 'reserved' and c.reserved_at < now() - interval '10 minutes'
    returning c.*
  ), led as (
    insert into northwind_contour.credit_ledger(credit_id, tenant_id, app_id, subject_id, kind)
    select s.id, s.tenant_id, s.app_id, s.subject_id, 'release' from stale s
    returning 1
  )
  select count(*) into v_released from led;

  return jsonb_build_object('expiredProposals', v_expired, 'deletedDecisions', v_decisions,
    'deletedUsage', v_usage, 'releasedReservations', v_released, 'prunedRateWindows', v_rate);
end;
```

```sql
-- 1. northwind: a role version for live Contour membership checks.
--    Existing users are backfilled to 1 by the default.
alter table northwind.users
  add column if not exists role_version integer not null default 1 check (role_version >= 1);

-- A role or team change bumps the version in the same row write, so open
-- agent proposals and sessions stop matching on their next call. Any other
-- update keeps the stored version, so the counter only moves forward.
create or replace function northwind.bump_role_version()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if new.role is distinct from old.role or new.team is distinct from old.team then
    new.role_version := old.role_version + 1;
  else
    new.role_version := old.role_version;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;

drop trigger if exists bump_role_version on northwind.users;

  before update on northwind.users
  for each row execute function northwind.bump_role_version();
```
